title: Remote-control session followed by USB mass-storage removal
qualification: Host-side observation only. Windows PnP records have one-second resolution. No camera-side log, no USB wire capture, no firmware claim.

sharedEvidence.conclusion: Both identities expose the same SD card; this is not a second or internal store.

usbEvent.detectionMethod: 3 s PnP presence poll; PnP LastRemovalDate records 00:08:29

runs.note: First GetCameraStatus timed out after 2 s; RCStartRemoteCtl was never sent, so this run is not a timing sample.

deltaStatement: All three removal events are consistent with approximately 68 s after session start; the one-second PnP resolution prevents a tighter claim.

idleWatch.method: Get-PnpDevice presence poll every 10 s; no disk I/O; no camera commands

keepalive.conclusion: Status polling did not postpone the removal; the timer is not reset by client commands.

recovery.recoveryCause: manual cable replug by the user

hostSideSettings.usbSelectiveSuspend: enabled (power scheme SCHEME_BALANCED, AC and DC index 1)
hostSideSettings.note: Idle control of 4 min 28 s showed no removal, so selective suspend is not the leading explanation. A disabled-suspend control run has not been performed.

limits: One body, one evening, three timing samples; not reproduced on another firmware version or another M1.
Approximately 68 s is an empirical host-side constant; no evidence that it is a firmware timer, and no firmware constant search has been performed.
No camera-side log and no USB wire-level capture; PnP timestamps have one-second resolution.
Cable and power delivery were not controlled for; Wi-Fi and HTTP stayed healthy through every removal.
Long-term automatic recovery beyond 4 min 27 s and 80 s was not observed.
operationalConsequences: The liveview capture path does not require USB and keeps working while the volume is absent (GetCameraStatus returned 200 during both removals).
Read the card before starting a remote session, or use a card reader; do not rely on the drive letter after a capture.
A manual replug is required after a removal.
